programme.title: Retour vers l'amour
programme.desc: Josie, responsable marketing, rentre chez elle lorsqu'elle devient la tutrice inattendue de sa nièce et de son neveu. Là-bas, elle renoue avec Cooper, son petit ami du lycée.

programme.title: Valley Girl
programme.desc: Dans cette adaptation du classique de 83, Julie (Jessica Rothe) incarne parfaitement la petite fille parfaite qui voit son univers bouleversé lorsqu'elle tombe amoureuse de Randy (Josh Whitehouse), un punk rocker d'Hollywood !

programme.title: Une nouvelle chance (2016)
programme.desc: Un avenir de jeune chef tendait les bras à Charlie. Pourtant sa vie semble s'être suspendue, habitant avec sa mère et son beau-père et travaillant dans le cinéma de son quartier, Charlie n'a plus de motivation pour rien...

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Mark a une vie de rêve : il est sur le point de devenir multimillionnaire et d'épouser son amour de jeunesse, Connie. Mais les choses ne sont parfaites qu'en surface : Mark découvre par hasard que Connie ne l'aime pas et compte juste voler sa fortune une fois le mariage prononcé.

programme.title: Golem, le Tueur de Londres
programme.desc: Le Londres victorien est terrorisé par un tueur en série inconnu qui laisse des messages énigmatiques écrits avec le sang de ses victimes. Lorsque les meurtres se multiplient, Scotland Yard confie l'affaire à un inspecteur célèbre.

programme.title: Park
programme.desc: Il est midi dans un parc isolé au pied des collines de Los Angeles.April est venue pour se suicider Krysta et Dennis s'échangent des tendresses dans sa voiture tandis que son collègue Ian attend dans une camionnette de lavage pour chiens Peg, l'épouse de Dennis, et sa meilleure amie Claire les ont suivis et prévoient une guérilla amoureuse et quatre jeunes trentenaires du même bureau discutent dans une autre camionnette.April demande de l'aide à Ian (du lubrifiant, un tuyau, un briquet), qui lui demande s'il peut l'accompagner.Claire et Peg piègent les amants dans la voiture de Dennis puis ont une conversation intime.Nathan et Babar avouent à Meredith et Cheryl qu'ils sont nudistes, tandis que Meredith insiste pour dire que les deux hommes sont gays. Les vêtements tombent et les vérités éclatent.Est-ce juste une journée de plus à Los Angeles ?

programme.title: Noël dans les prairies
programme.desc: Malgré les menaces constantes de son voisin ambitieux, Kendall Riley lutte héroïquement pour sauver le ranch familial. Dans un retournement de situation surprenant, Clint McCree, vétérinaire et fils de son voisin, arrive pour aider une vache en difficulté à mettre bas. Peu à peu, une romance naît entre eux, jusqu'à ce que les hommes de main du voisin dispersent le troupeau de Kendall, la poussant à se demander si l'intérêt de Clint est sincère ou s'il fait partie du plan de sa famille pour saboter ses terres. Rempli d'action, d'aventure et d'émotion, ce western moderne rend hommage aux petites villes, aux grands rêves et à la puissance de l'amour. Avec Erin Cahill (Saving Grace, Red Widow, Sleepy Hollow), Nicholas Gonzalez (The Good Doctor, Walker Texas Ranger), A Martinez (Longmire, The Cowboys, Days of our Lives) et Lindsay Wagner (Super Jaimie, Grey's Anatomy).

programme.title: L'Édition de l'Amour
programme.desc: La rédactrice beauté d'un magazine féminin convainc un photographe prometteur de prétendre être son petit ami lorsque son ex se fiance avec une autre. Ensemble, ils devront collaborer pour redorer la réputation déclinante du magazine.

programme.title: Code 37
programme.desc: Un écrivain se fait briser les doigts en sortant d'un cinéma porno où il a eu des rapports avec une étudiante. En enquêtant, Hannah découvre que le cinéma appartient à une connaissance, Vincent Manteau, également propriétaire d'une boîte de nuit, le « Sin City ». Elle apprend aussi que l'étudiante du cinéma, qui se prostitue, n'est autre que la nièce de Vincent Manteau. Peu après, le videur du « Sin City » est assassiné…

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: Un malentendu pousse des astronautes à attaquer, et les Mysterons promettent vengeance contre la Terre.

programme.title: Mon Premier Miracle
programme.desc: Une ado atteinte d'un cancer rare devient amie avec un fugitif ensemble, ils assistent à un miracle.

programme.title: The Neighbor
programme.desc: Un homme d'âge moyen voit sa vie bouleversée par une jolie jeune femme.

programme.title: L'Amour à la Carte
programme.desc: Une cheffe audacieuse tombe amoureuse de l'héritier improbable d'une chaîne de fast-food mexicain.

programme.title: Pas de plan pour Noël
programme.desc: "Si l'organisatrice d'événements Celeste Everett veut sauver son entreprise et offrir à sa nièce un joyeux Noël, elle a besoin d'aide. Mais lorsque la nounou qu'elle engage s'avère être un homme, Celeste réalise avec surprise qu'elle a peut-être aussi trouvé l'amour de Noël pour elle-même."

programme.title: La tempête de Noël
programme.desc: Bloqués par une tempête de neige avant Noël, Kayley et Brett tentent de rejoindre New York par leurs propres moyens. Mais leur halte forcée dans une petite ville ravive en eux la magie des fêtes.

programme.title: Une nouvelle tradition pour Noël
programme.desc: Carol vit pour Noël et sa ville la surnomme « Carol de Noël ». Mais l'arrivée d'un homme séduisant qui remet en question ses traditions pourrait bouleverser ses certitudes.

programme.title: Une romance entre les lignes
programme.desc: Ivy, éditrice de romances ambitieuse, aide un auteur de polars à intégrer plus d'amour dans son roman. Lorsqu'il devient son faux cavalier pour un mariage sur la plage, la fiction commence à ressembler à la réalité.

programme.title: Coup de foudre sous les flocons
programme.desc: Une photographe en quête d'un rare flocon de neige à douze côtés embarque avec une amie d'enfance dans une aventure hivernale qui pourrait transformer leur vie.

programme.title: The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: Ambitieuse productrice de talk-show, Abby Richter se targue de pouvoir trouver instantanément une solution à n'importe quel problème. Le seul qu'elle n'a pas réussi à résoudre, c'est son célibat. Lorsque le taux d'audience de son émission faiblit, Abby est obligée d'engager un nouvel animateur soi-disant expert en relations humaines, Mike Chadway. Dans l'émission, celui-ci traite de ce qui plaît vraiment aux hommes. Le choc est rude entre la jeune femme et ce provocateur odieux et macho. Le pire, c'est qu'il fait grimper l'audience et devient incontournable...

programme.title: Presque célèbre
programme.desc: Dans les années 70, William Miller, un adolescent de quinze ans, ne vit que pour la musique rock. Ce qu'il souhaite le plus au monde, c'est écrire des articles sur cette musique qu'il aime tant. Il envoie un essai au magazine Rolling Stone dans l'espoir de devenir journaliste.

programme.title: Loverboy
programme.desc: Devenue mère, une femme délaissée par ses parents étant jeune en arrive à trop couver son fils de sept ans. Sa rencontre avec un homme va changer la vie du jeune garçon, qui voit en cet étranger une figure paternelle…

programme.title: Le Sourire De Mona Lisa
programme.desc: En 1953, Katherine Watson, une jeune femme libre d'esprit, fraîchement diplômée de l'université de Bekerley, intègre la prestigieuse école pour filles de Wellesley pour enseigner l'histoire de l'art. Déterminée à affronter les mœurs dépassées de la société et de l'institution, elle va insuffler à ses étudiantes, dont Betty et Joan, l'envie de se dépasser et d'avoir le courage de mener l'existence qu'elles souhaitent réellement vivre.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: Afin de protéger une belle femme et son fils d'un braqueur, l'agent du FBI Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) est chargé d'une opération secrète consistant à se déguiser en femme âgée obèse afin d'enquêter sur un crime antérieur.

programme.title: Le Chevalier black
programme.desc: Jamal Walker est un employé de Medieval World, un parc à thème vétuste. Il se retrouve soudain projeté dans le passé, au cœur de l'Angleterre du XIVe siècle.

programme.title: Endiablé
programme.desc: Timide, Elliot Richards tente désespérément d'attirer l'attention d'Alison. L'occasion est donc trop belle lorsque le diable lui propose d'exaucer sept vœux en échange de son âme.

programme.title: George and the Dragon
programme.desc: Le jour où Luna, la fille du roi, disparaît, Georges, un valeureux chevalier, accompagné de son fidèle guerrier Garth, partent à la recherche de la princesse. En affrontant de multiples dangers, leur route va croiser celle dun gigantesque dragon et de dangereux mercenaires.

programme.title: L'homme du Minnesota
programme.desc: Emprisonné à tort pour un crime qu'il n'a pas commis, Minnesota Clay cherche à se venger de l'homme qui a dissimulé des preuves lors de son procès. Le hic : il devient aveugle.

programme.title: Django défie Sartana
programme.desc: Le frère du tueur de primes Django, Steve, est lynché après avoir été accusé d'un vol de banque.

programme.title: Arizona Bill
programme.desc: Un cavalier solitaire rencontre un soldat mourant, qui lui remet un papier autorisant le versement de 150 000 dollars à l'armée américaine.

programme.title: Viva! Django
programme.desc: Django est sur la piste de quelques hors-la-loi renégats qui ont violé et tué sa femme.

programme.title: La Chevauchée fantastique
programme.desc: Un groupe de personnes voyageant en diligence voit son voyage compliqué par la menace de Geronimo et apprend quelque chose sur les autres au passage.

programme.title: La mort était au rendez-vous
programme.desc: Un jeune tireur forme une alliance ténue avec un ancien hors-la-loi vieillissant pour traquer et éliminer les bandits qui ont tué sa famille, jusqu'à la fin surprenante.

programme.title: Le Rocher du Diable
programme.desc: Deux vieux amis se retrouvent dans des camps opposés pendant la guerre civile lors d'une bataille désespérée au sommet d'une montagne imprenable.

programme.title: Le retour de Billy the Kid
programme.desc: Rogers joue le rôle d'un sosie du défunt Billy The Kid et rétablit la tranquillité du comté de Lincoln après avoir maîtrisé les éléments criminels. Un bon divertissement.

programme.title: Les cavaliers du destin
programme.desc: Le méchant Kincaid contrôle l'approvisionnement local en eau et prévoit de se débarrasser des autres éleveurs. L'agent gouvernemental Saunders se présente sous couverture pour se débarrasser de Kincaid et gagner le cœur d'une de ses victimes, Fay Denton.

programme.title: On continue à l'appeller Trinita
programme.desc: Bambino essaie d'apprendre à son frère Trinity comment devenir un hors-la-loi, mais ils finissent par sauver une famille de pionniers et à défaire un réseau de contrebande.

programme.title: Murder In Law
programme.desc: La mère d'un jeune homme vient vivre avec lui à San Francisco, venue de Louisiane.Ce que le fils ignore, c'est que sa mère a été internée dans un hôpital psychiatrique en Louisiane, d'où elle s'est enfuie après avoir tué un infirmier.

programme.title: The House at the End of Time
programme.desc: Dulce est une jeune mère qui a des hallucinations. Elle voit des apparitions dans sa maison qui un jour déclenche la prophétie et tue tous les habitants sauf elle. Trente ans plus tard elle se réinstalle dans sa demeure afin d'élucider le mystère.

programme.title: L'Apocalypse
programme.desc: Alors qu'un astéroïde menace de s'écraser sur la Terre, Jason et Ashley recherchent en vain leur petite fille disparue. Face à la panique qui s'empare de la population, ils doivent garder la tête froide car leur temps est compté. Réussiront-ils à la retrouver saine et sauve avant la fin du monde ?

programme.title: Le Lac Maudit
programme.desc: Une famille en vacances renverse la situation face à un tireur de masse qui prétend combattre des forces démoniaques.

programme.title: Lavalantula
programme.desc: Des araignées géantes cracheuses de feu jaillissent d'anciens volcans dans les montagnes de Santa Monica. Leur objectif : détruire Los Angeles et ses alentours.

programme.title: Last survivors
programme.desc: Au lendemain d'un événement apocalyptique qui a contraint les gens à un isolement extrême. Un père et son fils rencontrent une étrangère qui menace de détruire l'utopie qu'ils ont construite.

programme.title: Bloody Sand
programme.desc: Lors d'une apocalypse zombie, une femme au passé trouble originaire de Las Vegas se retrouve acculée dans le désert avec un zombie solitaire et affamé à ses trousses.

programme.title: Les dieux des profondeurs
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une mission audacieuse conduit une équipe de sous-marin en eaux profondes dans une mystérieuse ouverture au fond de l'océan, ils découvrent un monde sous-marin perdu et réveillent son ancienne race d'êtres d'un autre monde...

programme.title: Super Shark
programme.desc: Un forage offshore réveille un requin préhistorique géant. La biologiste Kate enquête mais doit faire face aux manigances de Roger et Stewart. Aidée de Skipper et du DJ Dynamite Stevens, elle cherche à stopper le monstre, désormais capable de marcher sur terre : le Super Shark.

programme.title: Termination Point
programme.desc: Des expériences gouvernementales top secrètes sur le voyage dans le temps ont été arrêtées et jugées trop dangereuses pour continuer. Le scientifique principal a disparu avec la technologie et une chasse à l'homme est lancée par le gouvernement.

programme.title: Final days
programme.desc: Aidan se barricade chez lui face à l'invasion zombie et découvre une jeune femme piégée dans sa cour. Ensemble, ils cherchent une issue.

programme.title: Robocop: Les fantômes
programme.desc: Face à des expériences militaires dangereuses, Robocop doit agir vite pour sauver Diana et défendre des vétérans contaminés.

programme.title: Farscape: Faux retour
programme.desc: Crichton croit être revenu sur Terre, mais soupçonne un piège et doit distinguer illusion et réalité.

programme.title: The Last Exorcism
programme.desc: Pour sauver sa famille, un père engage trois exorcistes experts pour se débarrasser du démon qui possède son enfant.

programme.title: Mermaid le Lac des Âmes Perdues
programme.desc: Après une étrange rencontre nocturne, Roman est frappé par une malédiction liée à son passé. Sa fiancée Marina tente de le sauver, prête à tout pour briser l'emprise surnaturelle.

programme.title: Présentation du film Reign of Fire
programme.desc: Présentation du film Reign of Fire

programme.title: Reign of Fire
programme.desc: La princesse Elizabeth et ses guerriers traversent les terres interdites pour sauver leur royaume.

programme.title: Présentation du film RAGE
programme.desc: Présentation du film RAGE

programme.title: Rage
programme.desc: Lutobor, aidé d'un Scythe captif, traverse les steppes pour sauver sa famille au cœur de conflits meurtriers.

programme.title: Rottweiler
programme.desc: Laissé pour mort, un chien particulièrement féroce est réanimé et transformé par les laboratoires de l'armée en véritable cyborg.

programme.title: Sputnik : Espèce Inconnue
programme.desc: Un cosmonaute revient sur Terre… avec quelque chose en lui.

programme.title: Closer To God
programme.desc: Le généticien Victor Reed crée un clone humain, suscitant une vive controverse.

programme.title: Land Shark
programme.desc: Qian Cheng a installé un laboratoire de recherche biopharmaceutique au cœur de la jungle. Lorsque les chercheurs modifient l'ADN d'un requin pour développer un nouveau remède contre le cancer, ils créent involontairement un monstre.

programme.title: Ape vs Mecha Ape
programme.desc: L'armée fabrique sa propre I.A. prête au combat : Mecha Ape.

programme.title: Haute couture
programme.desc: Avec sa machine à coudre, une australienne transforme les femmes et exerce une douce vengeance.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Un jeune homme lutte pour retrouver son amour perdu lors de la construction du mur de Berlin.

programme.title: Hector et la recherche du bonheur
programme.desc: Hector, un psychanalyste londonien, se met à parcourir le globe à la recherche du bonheur.

programme.title: Route vers l'enfer
programme.desc: Mitchell et Carter, deux amis de longue date, se retrouvent en panne le long d'une route isolée en plein désert. Au fil des heures les tensions grandissent et finissent par exploser de manière assez brutale.

programme.title: The Last Fortress
programme.desc: Au 18ème siècle, l'Empereur de Russie Pierre le Grand mène une guerre contre les Suédois, afin de mettre fin aux conflits sanglants qui ravagent son empire.

programme.title: La bataille de Jangsari
programme.desc: 1950, en pleine guerre de Corée, une opération menée par le général Douglas MacArthur s'opère sur la ville portuaire d'Incheon afin de sécuriser l'endroit.

programme.title: Hungry Hearts
programme.desc: Jude est Américain, Mina Italienne. Ils se rencontrent à New York, tombent fous amoureux et se marient. Lorsque Mina tombe enceinte, une nouvelle vie s'offre à eux. Mais l'arrivée du bébé bouleverse leur relation.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Deux frères retournent dans la secte qu'ils ont fui des années auparavant...

programme.title: La Prophétie des ombres
programme.desc: Un reporter est dans une petite ville de Virginie pour enquêter sur une série d'événements étranges.

programme.title: La Vague
programme.desc: Un professeur de lycée explique à ses élèves la vie sous une dictature, l'expérience tourne mal.

programme.title: Evil Boy
programme.desc: Pour compenser la perte de son fils, un couple décide d'adopter, mais c'est un enfant difficile.

programme.title: King of Killers
programme.desc: Marcus Garan, ex-tueur à gages, accepte un contrat de 10 millions de dollars pour éliminer le plus redoutable assassin du monde. Arrivé à Tokyo, il découvre qu'il n'est pas seul : d'autres tueurs sont en lice. Tous entrent alors dans une traque mortelle où chacun peut devenir la cible.

programme.title: The Prison
programme.desc: Un ancien inspecteur de police en difficulté est emprisonné pour un délit de fuite. Dans la prison, il découvre que l'ensemble du pénitencier est contrôlé par un détenu qui dirige un syndicat du crime aidé par le directeur et les gardiens qui lui fournissent l'alibi parfait.

programme.title: Kung Fu Killer
programme.desc: Un tueur abat les plus grands maîtres d'arts martiaux et laisse derrière lui une arme nommée Moonshadow. Le détenu Hou Mo, expert en kung-fu, reconnaît sa technique et propose d'aider la police à l'arrêter, en échange de sa liberté.

programme.title: Bus 657
programme.desc: Luke Vaughn (Jeffrey Dean Morgan), un père désespéré, braque le casino du chef de la mafia Pope Silva (Robert De Niro) pour sauver sa fille malade. Le braquage tourne mal, obligeant Vaughn et son équipe à détourner un bus pour s'échapper.

programme.title: Trahison
programme.desc: Après une attaque terroriste à Los Angeles, six agents fédéraux se réfugient dans une planque ultra-sécurisée. Chacun commence à suspecter que le terroriste se cache parmi eux, semant la paranoïa et la tension au sein du groupe.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Un ancien criminel protège une jeune fille qui lui rappelle son enfant. Quand elle est menacée, il replonge dans la violence.

programme.title: Escadron 303
programme.desc: Pendant la bataille d'Angleterre, les pilotes polonais de l'escadron 303 affrontent la Luftwaffe avec courage, esprit de revanche et une détermination qui fera d'eux une unité redoutable.

programme.title: Sky Hunter
programme.desc: De jeunes pilotes fraîchement diplômés intègrent une unité militaire d'élite où ils doivent prouver leur valeur en mission.

programme.title: Gotti
programme.desc: John Gotti bâtit un empire mafieux à New York tout en tentant de préserver son fils, entre loyauté familiale, pouvoir et chute annoncée.

programme.title: You Might Be the Killer
programme.desc: Un animateur de colonie de vacances souffrant de trous de mémoire se retrouve entouré de victimes de meurtre. Il se tourne vers son amie passionnée de films d'horreur pour lui demander conseil et faire face au fait qu'il est peut-être le tueur.

programme.title: Rampant
programme.desc: Le Prince Ganglim, l'un des fils du roi au pouvoir, revient au royaume coréen de Joseon après de nombreuses années passées en captivité dans les geôles des Mandchous de la dynastie Qing. Des luttes pour obtenir le trône apparaissent bientôt au sein du palais royal alors qu'une épidémie transforme les humains en morts-vivants errants à la nuit tombée...

programme.title: Psycho Goreman
programme.desc: Après avoir déterré un joyau qui contrôle un monstre maléfique cherchant à détruire l'Univers, une jeune fille et son frère l'utilisent pour lui faire faire ce qu'ils veulent.

programme.title: Abandonnée
programme.desc: Marie hérite en Russie et découvre un double d'elle-même aux yeux vitreux.

programme.title: Deadly Cargo
programme.desc: Cinq amis partent faire de la plongée sous-marine et découvrent le cadavre d'un homme flottant à la surface. Leur bateau ayant coulé peu après suite à une avarie, ils se retrouvent seuls au milieu de l'océan.

programme.title: Dementia
programme.desc: Un vétéran atteint de démence découvre que son infirmière cache de terribles secrets.

programme.title: Baba Yaga : La Forêt des Damnés
programme.desc: Une nounou séduisante trouble Egor, qui doute bientôt de sa véritable identité.

programme.title: Life Like
programme.desc: Un couple recrute un androïde qui finit par dépasser son rôle.

programme.title: The Bone Collector
programme.desc: Criminologue de renom devenu tétraplégique, Lincoln Rhyme n'a plus qu'un désir : mourir. Il se convainc néanmoins de reprendre du service quand une effroyable série de crimes s'abat sur New York. Malgré ses réticences, Amelia Donaghy, une jeune recrue, va aider Rhyme. Elle sera ses yeux, ses mains, pour piéger le machiavélique meurtrier...

programme.title: Dragon Eyes
programme.desc: Le quartier de St Jude a sombré dans le chaos et la violence depuis qu'il est devenu l'enjeu d'une lutte sans merci entre deux gangs, celui de Dash et celui d'Antoine. La situation change le jour où arrive en ville un étranger nommé Ryan Hong. L'homme montre d'impressionnantes compétences martiales et il se voit courtisé par les deux clans. Refusant de prendre parti, il s'arrange pour multiplier les confrontations, aidé par son mentor, Tiano. Alors qu'il arrive à rendre confiance aux habitants du quartier, Hong est confronté à monsieur V, le cruel et corrompu chef de la police de la ville. L'affrontement entre les deux hommes devient inévitable...

programme.title: L'Affaire Roman J.
programme.desc: Avec la mort de son mentor, Roman J. Israel (Denzel Washington), avocat aussi idéaliste que déterminé, voit sa vie bouleversée. Recruté par l'ambitieux George Pierce (Colin Farrell), Roman se lie d'amitié avec une militante de l'égalité des droits (Carmen Ejogo). programme.title: Patric Gagne: 5% Of People Are Sociopaths
programme.desc: Sociopathy is a spectrum disorder affecting roughly 5% of the population. Patric Gagne is a sociopath who explains the difference between psychopaths and sociopaths. While sociopaths have access to inherent emotions like sadness and happiness, they struggle with learned social emotions like remorse, guilt, empathy, and love. Patric describes the apathy she experiences, which in the past led to anti-social behaviours like stealing cars and breaking into houses.

programme.title: Ashley James On Why Are Women Still Punished for Being Difficult
programme.desc: You're a bimbo. A nag. Too mumsy. Too bossy. Far from harmless words, Ashley James is clear they all work to shrink women and girls. In this chat with Fearne, Ashley recalls her first experiences of street harassment, and the way she victim blamed herself.

programme.title: Mary Berry: How Gardening Helped Me Through Grief
programme.desc: Mary Berry has been married for 60 years and says she and her husband have never had a cross word. Her secret? Do a lap of the garden before saying the thing you might regret. In this chat with Fearne, Mary shares the simple principles that have guided her life: be kind, contribute to community, and prioritise time in nature. Mary's 91, and her mum lived to 105.

programme.title: Dr Louise Newson On The Perimenopause Symptoms You're Ignoring
programme.desc: One in six women arriving at Dr Louise Newson's menopause clinic have suicidal thoughts. 92% see those thoughts reduce with natural hormones, so why are women still being prescribed antidepressants instead? Louise explains why women are being misdiagnosed with depression or anxiety when the root cause is hormonal. She walks through what the many different symptoms could look like, and how to talk to a GP about how you're feeling mentally and physically.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Millie Gooch On Alcohol, Consent, & Hangxiety
programme.desc: Alcohol-fuelled hangxiety became so overwhelming for Millie Gooch that she decided to stop drinking altogether and founded the Sober Girl Society. Now, with an MSc in Mental Health and Addiction, she's spent years exploring our complicated relationship with alcohol and what sits underneath it.

programme.title: Joseph Fiennes on Learning to Live With Uncertainty
programme.desc: Actor Joseph Fiennes discusses why he needs creative challenges to thrive, and how doubt can become a productive force rather than a barrier. He reflects on playing England football manager Gareth Southgate on stage and television, exploring parallels between their approaches to negotiating fear and encouraging vulnerability in men.

programme.title: Paul Whitehouse & Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE
programme.desc: Comedian Paul Whitehouse and his wife Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE, who has a PhD in neuroscience, discuss emotional regulation and neurodiversity. Mine shares her late ADHD diagnosis at 43 and childhood trauma, while Paul explores how physical health scares have changed his lifestyle. They discuss how the education system needs to change for neurodiverse children, the usefulness of labels, how to calm others with your own behaviour, and why this married couple choose not to live together.

He examines economic, military, and moral crises, from Western support for Israel to Donald Trump and rising authoritarianism. Jones explores the legacy of Iraq, Afghanistan, and Libya, deindustrialisation, stagnant wages, and the financial crash, arguing that decades of concentrated wealth have led to decline.

That money, he argues, was used to build the polling, messaging, and strategy that underpinned Starmer's rise.

programme.title: Jeannie And The Marriage Caper
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.title: G.I. Jeannie
programme.desc: Jeannie gets jealous on discovering that Tony has a sexy new secretary. Claiming to be a better one, Jeannie insists on joining the WAAFs and taking over the job. Remembering that his friend, Roger Healey, told him that all new WAAFs are being sent overseas, Tony agrees to help Jeannie to join. To her horror, she is sent to San Antonio for basic training. Jeannie has a series of disastrous tryouts in different job categories, in spite of her insistence that she wants an assignment as Captain Nelson's secretary when she becomes a WAAF.When Major Margaret Fiefeld assigns Jeannie as secretary to the commanding officer at the North African base instead, Jeannie folds her arms, blinks, and lands in Tony's office. Tony informs Jeannie that he is being sent to Nevada. Jeannie says she will resign and go with him. Tony then tells her that only troublesome, incompetent girls are discharged and that she cannot resign. Jeannie blinks again, the office is set is turmoil, and Tony resignedly welcomes Jeannie back to civilian life.

programme.title: The Yacht Murder Case
programme.desc: After promising to spend an evening with Jeannie, Tony is tricked by his superiors into conducting aerospace tycoon P.J. Ferguson on a tour of the base. Ferguson's daughter, Nina, de-cides that Tony is her man. P.J. persuades Tony's superior to order Tony to have cocktails aboard his yacht. When Jeannie protests, Tony imprisons her in the vacuum cleaner. Later, after P.J. has Tony assigned to a cruise on his yacht, Mrs. Flaherty, Tony's cleaning woman, accidentally releases Jeannie from the vacuum cleaner. She immediately takes off for the yacht.Jeannie disappears from the yacht during an argument with Tony. Nina and P.J. are certain he has pushed her overboard. Charged with murder, Tony is arrested. Roger Healey, certain Tony has lost his mind, agrees to go to Tony's house and tell the walls and the vacuum cleaner of Tony's plight, Jeannie goes to Tony's cell. Her appearance convinces P.J. that Tony is innocent. Later, searching for privacy, Jeannie and Tony climb into her bottle.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.7
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.27

A royal order is issued for Yukdo's execution, and a grief-stricken Gangcheon kneels before the palace gates in penitence.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.28
programme.desc: Mun Saseung is appointed as the new nangcheong of the Bunwon, and Jeongi becomes the first female master potter in Joseon history. Seeing Jeongi clad in her official potter's robes, Gwanghae smiles with pride and gifts her the workshop once used by Euldam. Reduced to desperation, Gangcheon and Yukdo beg Mun Saseung to allow them to remain at the Bunwon. Elsewhere, at the request of a Japanese merchant, Hwa-ryeong summons Jeongi—hinting at new trials yet to come.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.29
programme.desc: To protect Jeongi, Gwanghae arranges for a personal guard to stay by her side. programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.30
programme.desc: After hearing the full truth from Mapung, Jeongi breaks down in tears before Mun Saseung, who is left stunned and shaken. Jeongi then pleads with Gwanghae to delay Gangcheon's arrest just a little longer. Confronting Gangcheon herself, Jeongi is devastated once more when he coldly declares that Yukdo is the only bloodline he acknowledges. Claiming he wishes to atone, Gangcheon summons Jeongi to Euldam's grave.

There's only one place where you can find all these bucket list encounters – Australia!

programme.title: The Woman Who Loves Giraffes
programme.desc: Dr. Anne Innis Dagg re-traces the steps of her ground-breaking 1956 journey to South Africa to study giraffes in the wild. Now, at 85 years old, Anne sees a startling contrast between the world of giraffes she once knew and the one it has become. Weaving through the past and present, her harrowing journey gives us an intimate look into the factors that destroyed her career and the forces that brought her back.

programme.title: Secret Life Of Baby Owls
programme.desc: This stunning series uncovers 'The Secret Life Of Owls' as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

programme.title: Epic Safari Encounters: Sango Lodge
programme.desc: Craig joins Kristina at Sango Lodge in the heart of the Save Valley Conservancy where they explore the vast, rugged wilderness. Kristina joins Byrce Clemence and his anti-poaching team as they demonstrate the effectiveness of the anti-poaching dog unit. Tracking notorious rhino on foot keeps their senses alert. Find out what causes the crew to hit the floor.

programme.title: Ice Dogs
programme.desc: Conditions in the High Arctic are too extreme for either man or dog to survive alone but together we have become native to the vast white expanses. Here dogs became our greatest allies. They're our eyes, ears, strength and stamina our closest connection to a wild and unforgiving nature. In this magical yet unforgiving land, the enduring bond between human and canine goes beyond friendship to total mutual dependence. As one of the oldest breeds in the world, Greenland dogs are celebrated as the pinnacle of high performance and endurance in polar regions.

programme.title: Northern Woods
programme.desc: It is a musical film a a tributeto the Nordic forest: it shows its development from a primeval wood to a cultivated forest. Once populated by wild animals such as wolves, bears, eagles, deer and musk oxen, complex re-enactment-scenes shot by dollies and helicopters vividly depict the colonization of the forest by the Celts and Germans. But as time progressed, the northern forest has on numerous occasions fallen victim to environmental degradation and overexploitation. Several provisions were made to protect this wild beauty. The Helsinki resolution of 1993, which stipulated that the woods be used in a way and in a magnitude which guarantees their biological variety and productiveness and vitality, is but one measure put in place to secure the preservation of the natural gem. Time-lapse photography and breath-taking shots show our main protagonist – the woods – in its stunning glory. This beautiful wooded land, changes throughout the seasons. Our woodland is a world-renowned ecological jewel. It is famous, well-known and loved by tourists, forest economists, environmentalists, historians and intellectuals alike.

programme.title: Germany's Mystic Forest
programme.desc: 2.000 rivers and streams dig deep into the underground and transport their water into reservoirs or "Germany's Wild Amazon", the Wupper. These forests and rivers, together with heathlands and moors, are home to a diverse fauna. Martens, badgers, wild boars, hares, roe deer, and red deer, even black grouse and hazel deer find shelter in these parts. Wolves also have a dominant presence, not to mention those who live underground, such as lizards, bats, and snakes. Accompany us on a journey where we explore every corner of this rugged land. Climb underground into the Bergisches Land, through the vast hidden cave systems that sprawl far beneath the forests. There is also much to be discovered in the water, dive with us in crystal clear streams and rivers with their diverse flora and fauna.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: The 1st episode of the ARTE series "Adventure Turkey" shows the Mediterranean region: blossoming orchards, olive groves and "still" untouched nature frame historical treasures. In this environment, tradition and modernity engage in a daily confrontation. Is it better to preserve old craft traditions? Can they be brought into the modern age? Sabine Howe meets women who are swimming free, men who are clinging on - but above all people who are trying anew every day to resolve this question for themselves.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: The 2nd episode starts in Central Anatolia, goes through Cappadocia and ends near the Syrian border. Those who set off from Antalya on the coast inland will reach Isparta. In the rose-growing region, author Nadja Frenz is intoxicated by the intense scent of the Damascene rose, in Konya she meets the dancing Dervishes and discovers the fairytale landscape of Cappadocia. The journey ends with homemade liqueurs in Samandağ, where Christians, Jews, Alewites and Sunnis still live in peaceful harmony - just a few kilometers from the Syrian border.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: In episode 3, the journey goes to the almost forgotten region of Eastern Anatolia, which borders Armenia, Iran, Iraq and Syria. Accordingly, different cultures and religions mix here. The landscape is characterized by magnificent mountain ranges and endless steppes. Most people here live very simply, with sheep and goats adapted to the barren conditions and dry climate. The predominantly Kurdish society is still traditionally organized, with clear roles for women and men.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: The 4th episode takes us along the Black Sea coast. Author Claudia Wallbrecht uncovers the secret of the Tulum, a very special type of bagpipe, and accompanies a forest beekeeper on breakneck climbing adventures in the name of honey. The eastern Black Sea region borders on Georgia and Armenia, and here cultures, languages and ethnic groups have been mixing for centuries: for example, Hemşin, Lasen and the descendants of Pontic Greeks. They all shape the region - and this episode - with their music, architecture, food and ancient customs.

programme.title: Rainbow: Live in Munich
programme.desc: Rainbow was formed by Ritchie Blackmore in 1975 after he left Deep Purple at the height of their fame. They were instantly successful and released a string of hit albums, with an ever changing line-up, between 1975 and 1983 when Blackmore broke up the group to join the reformed Deep Purple. This concert from their European tour in 1977 features the line-up responsible for the Long Live Rock n Roll album released later that year, including vocalist Ronnie James Dio and drummer Cozy Powell. Blackmore had to be smuggled out of Austria after a trouble with the police at a gig two nights earlier and was very late arriving in Munich, all of which seemed to inspire both the band and the audience to create a truly remarkable gig.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Her vision is to have the girls model her fashions in a parade past the town fountain. What she didn't realize is that the Berrykins are turning the fountain into a big water show. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry is disappointed in the girls' lack of enthusiasm for the Patti Persimmon mystery novels, her favorite book series. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of the Disappearing Dog Show
programme.desc: When Huckleberry and Blueberry's Patti Persimmon-style mystery story is rejected by an online mystery magazine, Blueberry and Huck have to come up with a new way to raise support for Huckleberry's Hotel for Homeless Pets back in Berry Big City. Strawberry suggests they hold a big dog show! Plum makes over-ambitious plans to display talents that her dog does not quite have, trying to teach him complicated dance routines.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The Baby Berrykins are enthralled by a fairytale that Blueberry reads to them for Story Time. Charmed by their reaction, Strawberry suggests that the girls do a "berrytale play" for the kids, sort of a "Story Time On Stage." Plum volunteers to direct it. She envisions a small, simple production-until she hears about a gigantic production of "Snowberry and the Seven Berrykins" that's a smash hit in Berry Big City.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and the girls excitedly plan to put on a "Story Time On Stage" musical play for the Berrykin kids: "Berryella and Prince Berry Charming," directed and choreographed by Plum, with musical direction by Cherry. Strawberry will play Berryella, with Lemon and Blueberry as her comically jealous stepsisters, and costume designer Raspberry as her Fairy Fashionmother.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: The Mask Of Deception
programme.desc: When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers. The ninja find themselves scattered to the four corners of the kingdom. Cole and Jay are searching in vain for some sign of Master Wu. Nya fights injustice in the north, while Kai and Zane attempt to fend off an angry lava beast in the west. This leaves Lloyd alone in Ninjago City. He rushes to the scene of a heist at Borg Tower and finds himself up against a team of highly trained operatives led by the mysterious masked MISTER-E. Lloyd fails to prevent the heist and an ancient artifact, the MASK OF DECEPTION, is stolen. Lloyd apprehends one of the criminals but the others escape. Dismayed by his failure, Lloyd calls the ninjas back to Ninjago. The friends are reunited and hope for a little rest and relaxation. These hopes are dashed with the arrival MASTER HUTCHINS, a servant of the Royal Family of Ninjago, who has been sent by the EMPEROR to request their help. A new criminal gang, SONS OF GARMADON (SOG), is attempting to acquire three ancient masks called the ONI MASKS, which are rumored to possess supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Gray Knight
programme.desc: Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. In the heat of the battle, the Cloud of Monstrox sees the stone statue of Clay and zaps him to life! Clay is now turned, and is fighting against his friends. It is impossible for them to defeat him without destroying him for good. The Cloud urges Clay on. He attacks the Fortrex in order to get to Merlok. Robin in his Black Knight Mech is trying to stop him, but to no avail. Merlok 2.0 is left undefended. At the very last moment Merlok 2.0 unleashes a blasting spell that sends Clay far far away.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Girls on Mission
programme.desc: Olivia tapes a science show, with a little help from Mia's lemonade stand - and special effects! Andrea relaxes at the beach while Emma is hard at work at her lifeguard tower. Mia and Stephanie have to use a little horse power at the Sunshine Ranch. Stephanie has to face her fears when the class gets an 'Animal Kingdom & 'school assignment.'Things are getting mixed up on Andrea's first day on the job at Heartlake City Juicebar. Emma and Stephanie accidentally rent a scary movie and suddenly there are beasts everywhere...

programme.title: The Hands Of Time
programme.desc: Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time. But the arrival of the first Time Blade – a weapon with the power to speed up time – sends the Ninja to the Monastery just in time to rescue their master from certain doom.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated. But with Wu out of action and suffering from the effects of the Time Punch, the Ninja discover a new enemy in their midst: The Vermillion Warriors. And the Ninjas have no idea who controls them...

programme.title: A Time Of Traitors
programme.desc: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, as the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree, Lloyd struggles with his role as master-in-training and Nya does her best to reboot Zane, who was knocked off line in his first battle with the Vermillion.

They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.10
programme.desc: Wonguk's condition suddenly deteriorates, forcing Minwoo and Jaein to rush into emergency treatment. As the media proposes producing a documentary about Wonguk's story, the hospital chairman orders Minjun to save the patient—regardless of who performs the surgery.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.11
programme.desc: The chairman asks Inhyuk what is needed to establish a trauma center, leaving Inhyuk torn over whether to bring the highly skilled Euna onto the team. Meanwhile, Inhyuk, Jaein, and Minwoo face a harrowing dilemma: deciding who to operate on first—a kidnapper who knows the child's whereabouts, or an injured detective.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.12
programme.desc: Confronted once again with moments of solitude and choice at the patient's bedside, Minwoo and Jaein are forced to reflect on what it truly means to face a life alone. Meanwhile, a patient with a shattered pelvis is rushed in, and Seongjin—who has fellowship experience in pelvic surgery—comes down from Orthopedics, only to hesitate over whether to proceed with the operation.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.13
programme.desc: During a dinner together, Inhyuk offers his congratulations to Euna and her fiancé, but an unmistakable tension lingers between the two men. Meanwhile, the ER is flooded with patients stung by jellyfish after a seaside outing—only to be thrown into further chaos when three men and women arrive with shotgun wounds.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.14
programme.desc: As Minwoo and Jaein clash over opposing views on amputating Wonguk's leg, the announcement of support for a new trauma center further clouds the decision on whether to proceed with surgery. Meanwhile, Minwoo struggles to understand Jaein's unusually sympathetic approach toward the kidnapper Yoo Seung-cheol.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.15
programme.desc: Though Wonguk's leg amputation is successfully completed and the team breathes a collective sigh of relief, Minwoo is left conflicted as he gazes at the severed limb. Watching Euna hand over her duties and prepare to leave for Canada, Inhyuk is overcome with memories from the past.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.16
programme.desc: When Daeje, suffering from severe headaches and unable to even stand, is rushed into the ER, tension grips the hospital. Unaware that Jaein is Daeje's granddaughter, Minwoo stays by her side, watching over a visibly shaken and distraught Jaein.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is Kim Sa-wol! This artist made her big debut in 2014 as a member of the folk duo Kim Sawol x Kim Hae Won and enchanted many with the debut mini-album Secret. That year the two won the Best Rookie Artist and the Best Folk Album at the prestigious Korean Music Awards. The next year Kim Sa-wol released her first solo album Suzanne and then the second solo album Romance winning a total of 5 awards at the Korean Music Awards between 2014 and 2018. This past September Kim Sa-wol dropped her third release as a solo artist. Titled Heaven It illustrates her honest stories and feelings including loneliness life's uncertainty frustration and more. Her wispy voice and the bittersweet mood blend well in this new masterpiece. In this episode Kim Sa-wol performs Disposable KEY Fugitive Yellow Signal and Someone to offer an exquisite glimpse into her stunning musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy her intimate dreamy music!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE are the beloved monkies of the Korean music industry - JANNABI! JANNABI is an old-fashioned Korean word for “monkey” and this band made their debut in 2014 with the digital single Rocket. Since then they have impressed numerous listeners with their retro-infused music that portrays various stories of the youth ranging from love to separation to frustration. Last year the band released their second full-length album Legend and topped all the music charts with the album's lead track for lovers who hesitate. Before releasing their third full-length album next year the band dropped a new mini-album just a week ago and this time as a duo to nourish listeners' hearts. In this episode JANNABI performs both their latest tracks and hit songs - A thought on an autumn night Old dog Sweet memories and Step from their new album JANNABI's Small Pieces 1 as well as Summer and for lovers who hesitate. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy a beautiful autumn day with these talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a top-notch vocalist and songwriter Kim Bo-kyung (Neon)! This artist first made herself known to the public in 2010 through Superstar K2 and caused a real sensation with her rendition of Kelly Clarkson's Because of You. The following year she made her official debut with the first mini-album The First Day and then took part in the soundtracks of numerous TV series and films starting with School 2013. Recently Kim Bo-kyung (Neon) dropped the new digital single Why Am I? It's her first new song in 5 months with an intense guitar riff and band sound. 5 months back she released the song Let's Walk Through The Flower Path to offer a message of comfort to listeners as we are all going through the pandemic era. In this episode this musician performs That night That day (010)Unknown Call Let's Walk Through The Flower Path Love Yourself Why Am I? and Don't Think You're Alone. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy Kim Bo-kyung (Neon)'s kaleidoscopic musicality!

programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer's festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

programme.title: Flour Power Holiday Specials

In this holiday special, host Jessica McGovern takes us through three new and exciting treats to bring to your table, sharing some of her favourite tips and tricks along the way. Jessica offers up three alternatives to a standard Thanksgiving dessert - serving up light and flaky Pie Fries with Apple Caramel Dip, a rich and creamy Sweet Potato Pie, and a luscious Vanilla Bourbon Sweet Potato Pie Cake coated in a fluffy marshmallow frosting. These quick and easy recipes will put you in the holiday spirit while adding a new taste to classic desserts.
